title: Scheduled sweep dispatched full CI eight times on draft PR #1596
detail: Every push to claude/new-session-neniem produced zero pull_request check runs, so the 20-minute sweep dispatched ci.yml on each new head. Four of the eight pushes were docs-only commits that still ran the full pyramid because dispatch classifies the whole branch delta.

evidence.counterfactual: No dispatched pyramids on a draft head; the PR run would cover the head when its webhook fires.

title: Close or rebase draft PR #1596 and make the sweep skip draft heads older than 7 days
action: Add `--json isDraft,createdAt` to the sweep's `gh pr list` call and `continue` when isDraft and age > 7d; independently, find out why pushes to that branch fire no pull_request events (compare the branch's workflow files with main).
risk_note: A stale draft loses automatic CI until it is rebased; the PR run still fires on ready_for_review.

title: mutation-changed runs 15 minutes on every push to a PR
detail: 41 jobs, median 15 min, maximum 24 min, on every synchronize. The workflow comment says the scoped run takes seconds; the selector is not narrowing as designed.

evidence.counterfactual: One run per PR per day (ready_for_review or label) instead of every push.

title: Run mutation-changed once per review round, not per push
action: Trigger the job on `pull_request: types: [ready_for_review]` or a `mutation` label, keep the weekly sweep and the deploy gate; measure `--changed` selection size before trusting it again.
risk_note: A mutation regression is caught one review round later instead of on the push.

title: Four full mutation shards re-run on every merge to main
detail: Nine deploys each ran gate-mutation-1..4 (about 33 min per deploy) after Checks had passed on the identical tree SHA.

evidence.counterfactual: Skip the gate when a Checks run succeeded on the same tree SHA.

title: Skip the deploy gate when Checks passed on the same tree SHA
action: Port MAX3 ci.yml's tree-SHA already-validated step into deploy.yml and condition the four gate-mutation jobs on it.
risk_note: A manual dispatch on an unvalidated tree must still run the gate; keep the safe default when no matching check is found.

title: SFTP upload spawns one curl per file and takes 19 to 33 minutes per deploy
detail: The deploy job spent 184 paid minutes in nine runs, almost all in the per-file upload loop.

evidence.counterfactual: A single mirrored transfer (lftp mirror --reverse --parallel or tar plus remote extract) takes about 2 minutes.

title: Replace the per-file curl loop with one parallel mirror and skip deploys that change nothing shipped
action: Use `lftp -e 'mirror --reverse --parallel=8 --only-newer public/ REMOTE'` (host key pinned as today) or upload one tarball and extract remotely; add a paths filter so merges outside the shipped payload do not deploy.
risk_note: lftp must honour the pinned host key; verify with the existing smoke test.

title: 288 minutes of runs cancelled by a newer push to the same PR
detail: Rapid pushes superseded runs mid-way; four fix/ollama-keepalive runs in 12 minutes burned 72 minutes before cancellation.

evidence.counterfactual: One push per review round, or a concurrency group per PR that cancels every workflow of the PR.

title: Batch commits locally and push once per review round
action: Session guidance: squash local commits and push when the round is ready; widen `concurrency.group` to the PR number across Checks, review lanes and CI so one push cancels all stale work at once.
risk_note: None; behaviour change for sessions, not for the repositories.

title: Gemini review runs about 5 minutes on every push
detail: 48 jobs for three PRs; fetch-depth 0 and an uncached pip install dominate.

evidence.counterfactual: One review per PR on opened and ready_for_review, shallow checkout, cached pip.

title: Review on opened and ready_for_review only; drop fetch-depth 0; cache pip
action: Change `types:` to `[opened, ready_for_review]`, use `fetch-depth: 2` and diff against the merge base, add `cache: pip` to setup-python.
risk_note: Pushes after opening are not re-reviewed until ready_for_review.

title: Four-shard backend pyramid runs on every synchronize
detail: 14 full pyramids across three PRs in three hours on 2026-09-05; about 45 paid minutes per push.

evidence.counterfactual: Shard-scoped unit tier on synchronize; full four-shard pyramid on ready_for_review and main.

title: Unit tier on synchronize, full pyramid on ready_for_review
action: Condition the `backend` matrix on `github.event.action != 'synchronize' || github.event.pull_request.draft == false` and add a single-shard unit-tier job for draft synchronize events using the existing unit-tier selector (currently observe-only).
risk_note: Integration and system tiers are validated one step later on drafts; main and ready PRs are unchanged.

title: $12.07 of Actions spend is not attributable to any visible repository
detail: The billing page's 'All other repositories' line exceeds any single repository; the three older private repositories have zero runs. The spend is in a repository the GitHub App is not installed on, a deleted repository, or a non-Actions product.

evidence.counterfactual: Every billed repository is collected by github_actions_runs.

title: Filter the billing page to Actions and download the usage report; install the app on any repository that appears
action: Settings → Billing → Usage: product filter Actions, expand the repository list, download the CSV; add missing repositories to the github_actions_runs config and to the GitHub App installation.
